text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Unions still uncertain about proposed system to replace VAT. The General Workers' Union says it would be difficult for prices to go down once they went up because of VAT. Prime Minister Alfred Sant said the government expected prices of essential products to go down once VAT was replaced.
- Concern over declining summer jobs for university students.

- EU External Relations Minister Hans Van Den Broek to visit Malta on May 26. Prime Minister Alfred Sant said there will be talks on a new relationship between Malta and the EU now that Malta has frozen its application to join the union.
